context_requirements: Functional cholinergic synaptic machinery for canonical acetylcholine release enhancement
Expression of MAOA/MAOB if monoamine oxidase inhibition contributes to the mechanism
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage for a robust transcriptional response
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that matches known MAO inhibitor or cholinergic pathway activation signatures
Enrichment of MAOA/MAOB-dependent gene sets after treatment
